contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: No explicit constraint_id in structured_contract.json for collection name validation beyond endpoint definition
contract_grounding.note: Source code validation at src/actix/api/mod.rs:33-39 (StrictCollectionPath) uses validate_collection_name which only blocks INVALID_NAME_CHARS [<, >, :, ", /, \, |, ?, *, \0, \u{1F}]. Spaces and apostrophes are not checked, allowing invalid names through.

Script observes names with spaces/apostrophes succeeding with HTTP 200 when they should be rejected with 4XX. Contract implies name validation but enforcement is incomplete.
